Rayquaza VMAX values depend on the set and card number

2026-11-05

Rayquaza VMAX appears in several English products with different numbers and artwork. Match the whole record before using a Rayquaza VMAX price. Evolving Skies 218/203, Crown Zenith 102/159 and Silver Tempest TG20/TG30 are not interchangeable copies.

Compare selected English Rayquaza VMAX records

These Card AI catalog samples were retrieved November 5, 2026. The finish is Holofoil for each selected record; the set and collector number still distinguish them.

These are separate record samples, not a low-to-high valuation range for any Rayquaza VMAX. The samples do not specify a raw condition or slab grade. They are not offers, completed-sale records or guaranteed resale values.

Why 111/203 needs more than a number

The catalog also has a Jumbo Cards Rayquaza VMAX 111/203 record and a Prize Pack Series Cards record with that number. They are excluded from the table above. A larger card or a stamped product record must not borrow the regular Evolving Skies record's price. Confirm the product, size, artwork and any stamp before selecting a candidate.

The official Evolving Skies 218/203 page provides an artwork and number reference. Use the printed number and artwork together rather than relying only on a seller's descriptive label. Japanese records are also separate from the English samples shown here.

How to check the value of your copy

In the Card AI app, search for Rayquaza VMAX with its set or full number. You can also start with the Pokemon card scanner. Review likely matches and confirm the printing, language and finish. Record the actual raw condition, or the company and grade on an existing slab.

Then use the card price checker to inspect that record's available price and history. Do not substitute the 218/203 sample if another record or condition has no published price. Save the confirmed copy in your collection if you own it.

Other Pokemon value references

The Moonbreon guide covers another Evolving Skies printing problem. Browse Pokemon card value guides for other characters or use a specific set checklist to confirm the numbering.
